cc:Work.dc:description: Illustration with synthetic data, random seed 14. Exact Gaussian linear regression with known observation SD=0.55 and N(0,4I) coefficient prior. Pointwise 95% posterior intervals for the mean and posterior predictive intervals for a new noisy observation.
